name: faktor
description: An engineering agent in your editor: describe a task, follow the run, approve what it needs, and land verified changes.

faktor.autoStart.description: Start the daemon when the extension activates.

faktor.defaultProvider.description: Provider id for new sessions; empty uses the first model in the daemon catalog.

faktor.defaultModel.description: Model id for new sessions; empty uses the first model in the daemon catalog.

enumDescriptions: Work in an isolated copy of the workspace and only land verified changes (explicit).
Use the Faktor default: an isolated copy of the workspace.
faktor.mutationMode.description: Where new task runs make their edits. Faktor always works in an isolated copy of the workspace and only lands changes after verification passes; leave the default unless you are diagnosing execution modes.

faktor.budgetTokens.description: Token budget for a new run (0 = no limit).

faktor.budgetCostMicro.description: Maximum cost a new run may spend, in millionths of a dollar (0 = no limit).

faktor.binaryPath.description: Explicit path to the faktor-cli binary (overrides FAKTOR_BIN and the target/debug|release lookup).

faktor.dataDir.description: Persistent daemon data directory; empty uses the daemon default.

faktor.installRoot.description: Install root holding the immutable release layout (current, launcher, versions/). When a layout exists there the daemon is spawned through the stable bootstrap launcher, so the activated release and only that release runs; empty resolves to <faktor.dataDir>/install (or ~/.faktor/install), with the legacy binary lookup as the fallback when no layout exists.

faktor.startupTimeoutMs.description: How long to wait for the daemon startup line before failing (must exceed the bootstrap launcher's ~30 s launch window).

faktor.controlPlaneEndpoint.description: Cloud control-plane endpoint the stored credential belongs to. Non-secret: it is half of the SecretStorage key (endpoint + organization), never a credential.

faktor.controlPlaneOrganization.description: Organization (or account) id the stored control-plane credential belongs to. Non-secret: written by "Faktor: Sign in to Control Plane".

faktor.controlPlaneAuthSession.description: Auth-session id (non-secret) the stored credential owns, from the SSO callback or bootstrap result. Written by "Faktor: Sign in to Control Plane"; used only to name the session in the daemon's sign-out revoke body. Never a credential.

faktor.controlToken.deprecationMessage: Deprecated plaintext credential. The extension never sends this value to control-plane routes; sign in through "Faktor: Sign in to Control Plane" to store the credential in the OS/IDE secret store (this setting is deleted once migrated).
faktor.controlToken.description: DEPRECATED (plaintext, never sent): legacy control-plane credential kept only so the one-shot migration prompt can find and delete it. Use "Faktor: Sign in to Control Plane" instead; the local daemon password is handled separately and is unchanged.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Faktor
walkthroughs.description: An engineering agent that can inspect, modify and verify this workspace.

steps.title: Ask Faktor to do something
steps.description: Open Faktor and describe the task in plain language. Faktor works in an isolated candidate workspace and only integrates verified changes.

steps.title: Inspect what Faktor is doing
steps.description: The current run and the conversation stay primary. Use **Inspect** for run details, agents, the coordination board and evidence.

steps.title: Choose how work finishes
steps.description: Set **Finish when done** in the composer to commit, push or open a pull request once verification passes.
